title: scene-00: visitor avatar assets unreachable
description: Found while citing OpenSimulator Hypergrid (jmap-chat-spec-9k91). SceneAvatar.visualRef is a blobId in the region's hosting account, so a visitor's avatar model (e.g. a VRM .glb) must be uploaded into that account to be seen. Hypergrid serves a visitor's assets from the home grid's asset service and notes the destination operator can copy them. If cross-operator entry (jmap-chat-spec-gu2w) is pursued, Scene needs a way to reference a visitor's avatar asset held elsewhere (e.g. assetUri on SceneAvatar, or a jmap: object URI) plus security text on copying and fetch. Blocked on gu2w decision.
